title: "The Biology of the Flying Saucer—I", The Aeroplane, 13 Feb 1948 (A. R. Weyl)
description: Magazine page from The Aeroplane (February 13, 1948, p. 185) with the article "The Biology of the Flying Saucer—I: The Story of Low Aspect Ratio Aircraft" by A. R. Weyl, A.F.R.Ae.S. It includes a photograph of a Chance Vought low-aspect-ratio twin-propeller aircraft, Fig. 1 drawings of the "Turbine flying machine" project of Munich engineer Gustave Koch (1893/1894), and Fig. 2 diagrams defining aspect ratio for aerofoil, pteroid and apteroid shapes. Handwritten "Inc 6" at lower left.
